description: Interactively curate a staged portfolio selection in Chat / MCP: add new parcels, remove sold or NNN properties, toggle selection, set Primary Residence / Homestead HQ, or execute natural language instructions with TypeSafe System One (Jev). Recalculates selected parcel counts, total market value, and estimated annual tax recovery in real-time.

address_or_parcel_id.description: Target street address, parcel ID, or street name token (e.g. '4006 Brock Rd' or 'Brock Rd')

conversational_instruction.description: Natural language instruction from user in chat (e.g. 'Remove Brock Rd because we are selling it next week, keep the rest')

reason.description: Reason for exclusion or modification (e.g. 'under contract to sell', 'NNN lease')

staged_properties.description: Array of staged property objects from previous staging/curation turn

name: curate_portfolio_selection
